description: This file contains functions and macros for URL normalization, comparison, and matching, including parsing and handling URL components such as scheme, host, port, path, and user info in a URL handling library.

methods.name: int append_normalized_escapes(struct strbuf * buf,const char * from,size_t from_len,const char * esc_extra,const char * esc_ok)
methods.description: Escapes or unescapes characters in a string according to URL encoding rules, normalizing percent-encodings to uppercase.

methods.name: const char * end_of_token(const char * s,int c,size_t n)
methods.description: Finds the position of the next occurrence of a character in a string or the end of the string.

methods.name: int match_host(const struct url_info * url_info,const struct url_info * pattern_info)
methods.description: Compares the host parts of two URL info structures, with support for wildcards.

methods.name: char * url_normalize_1(const char * url,struct url_info * out_info,char allow_globs)
methods.description: Performs URL normalization, including case conversion, unescaping, path resolution, and removal of default ports.

methods.name: char * url_normalize(const char * url,struct url_info * out_info)
methods.description: A wrapper for url_normalize_1 with default parameters.

methods.name: size_t url_match_prefix(const char * url,const char * url_prefix,size_t url_prefix_len)
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches a given prefix, considering boundary conditions.

methods.name: int match_urls(const struct url_info * url,const struct url_info * url_prefix,struct urlmatch_item * match)
methods.description: Checks whether two URLs match based on scheme, host, port, and path.
